mode: verbatim ingest, embedding backend (qwen3-embedding:0.6b via an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, brute-force cosine), default recall stages, no LLM, precise recall profile
how: config.build_gateway(dict); EmbeddingBackend.put_many([(text, id, date)]) once for all memories; Gateway.recall('owner', {'query': q}) for deployed; EmbeddingBackend.find(query, 10) for ranked
notes: Backend is the embedding backend: model qwen3-embedding:0.6b, cosine mapped to 0..1 with floor 0.35 and ceil 0.80 (the backend's values for this model, chosen on the development sets, not on this data); query prefix set, document prefix none.
ranked scores are the mapped relevance values, not comparable across systems.

deployed uses the default recall stages with [recall] profile = 'precise' pinned (min_score with the backend's precise line 0.20, relative_score with its ratio 0.95, fill_text, drop_oversize, redact, dedupe, budget) and the default limit of 5; ms times that Gateway.recall call only. The plain run of this backend uses the broad lines 0.15 and 0.65 instead.

Precise profile: [recall] profile = 'precise' makes min_score and relative_score use the precision-leaning lines of this backend (min_score 0.20, ratio 0.95 instead of the broad 0.15 and 0.65), chosen on the development set by the balanced rule of bench/dev_eval.py (delivered F1 weighted with the quiet rate). It answers fewer questions and stays quiet more often than the default.
Deployed items are reported by the id field of each recall item; 0 item(s) named no dataset memory.
0 recall call(s) did not answer 200; 0 ranked search(es) failed.
deployed was timed before ranked, so ms includes the real query embedding request; ranked then reuses the backend's query-embedding cache.
Gateway.recall was called directly, so the per-client rate limiter (applied only in admit) was not involved.
Memories were ingested with one put_many call (embedding requests of 32 texts); ingest_seconds covers it.
